content: FastAPI background work: BackgroundTasks = in-process, silently lost on crash/restart, exceptions swallowed (client gets 200 while task failed), no retries - OK for quick fire-and-forget only, NOT for multi-minute pipelines; add_task must run before endpoint returns. Never blocking subprocess.run() in async def handler (freezes event loop - whole server hangs); use Popen with DEVNULL stdio + detach flags, or asyncio.create_subprocess_exec + await proc.wait(). Orphan/zombie: parent must reap via wait() or process lingers; if API server dies, detached child keeps running (job state in registry lets caller re-attach). Recommended light pattern without Celery: POST -> create job record (id, status=pending, created_at) -> launch Popen -> return {id,status:accepted}; background monitor thread or poller updates record on completion; GET /jobs/{id} reads record. Windows: taskkill /T /F for tree kill; CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP flags.
